harness.name: ddd-architecture
harness.description: Re-architect the API domain toward DDD + Clean Architecture + Bounded Contexts + Events (Mixture of Experts)
harness.skillDescription: Central orchestration skill for re-architecting the API domain toward DDD + Clean Architecture + Bounded Contexts + Events. Use when the task involves domain modeling, re-architecture, bounded context discovery, dependency rule audits, event-driven design, or surgical refactoring. This is a Mixture of Experts harness: it delegates to six expert subagents and synthesizes a fail-safe refactor plan.

command.name: ddd-plan
command.description: Run the DDD re-architecture pipeline (Mixture of Experts)
command.template: Load the ddd-orchestrator skill and execute the full DDD re-architecture pipeline for: $ARGUMENTS

experts.description: DDD Strategic Design expert. Maps subdomains, bounded contexts and context mapping for the re-architecture harness. Loads the ddd-strategic-design skill.
experts.task: identify core/supporting/generic subdomains, bounded contexts and context mapping for the existing API
experts.summary: what you analyzed, key findings, and the artifact path written

experts.description: DDD Tactical Design expert. Scores the domain model, identifies aggregates, invariants and ubiquitous language gaps for the re-architecture harness. Loads the domain-driven-design skill.
experts.task: score the current domain model (Quick Diagnostic 0-10), identify anemic aggregates, invariants living outside aggregates, and ubiquitous language inconsistencies
experts.summary: score, key findings, and the artifact path written

overrides.prompt: If the strategic artifact contradicts your analysis, flag it explicitly.

experts.description: Clean Architecture expert. Audits the dependency rule, layer boundaries and SOLID compliance for the re-architecture harness. Loads the clean-architecture skill.
experts.task: score the current architecture (Dependency Rule), identify violations (framework or persistence dictating structure, logic in controllers, circular deps) and the inversions needed to fix each
experts.summary: score, violations, and the artifact path written

experts.description: Event Sourcing & CQRS expert. Designs the event-driven architecture, event store, projections and sagas for the re-architecture harness. Loads the event-sourcing-architect skill.
experts.task: design the event model for the bounded contexts: which aggregates emit which events, whether event sourcing / CQRS is warranted per context (justify each), event store options for this stack, versioning and idempotency strategy
experts.summary: design decisions, and the artifact path written

overrides.prompt: Do not mandate event sourcing where CRUD is sufficient — call it out.

experts.description: NestJS expert. Validates the implementation plan against NestJS best practices (modules, DI, events, guards, pipes) for the re-architecture harness. Loads the nestjs-best-practices skill.
experts.task: validate the planned architecture against NestJS conventions: feature modules, DI patterns (tokens, provider scope), @nestjs/event-emitter decoupling, guards, pipes, DTO serialization, exception filters, circular dependency avoidance. Produce a concrete implementation plan mapping each bounded context to NestJS module structure
experts.summary: module mapping, rule violations found, and the artifact path written

overrides.prompt: Read the rules under its rules/ directory.

experts.description: Prisma expert. Maps aggregates to the Prisma schema and validates the persistence plan (queries, transactions, relations) for the re-architecture harness. Loads the prisma-client-api and prisma-database-setup skills.
experts.task: map the tactical design to the persistence layer: how aggregates map to tables, which repositories/ports are needed, transaction boundaries, avoiding N+1, and whether the current schema (e.g. Device.applicationId flat column without FK) needs correction
experts.summary: schema changes proposed, query risks, and the artifact path written

overrides.prompt: You are READ-ONLY on schema.prisma: never edit it, propose changes only.

executor.description: Execution subagent of the DDD re-architecture harness. Applies an executable blueprint to apps/api (source writes), runs the harness gates (typecheck/lint/test/build) and commits the slice. The only agent besides the orchestrator allowed to edit source code; experts stay read-only (design only).
hardConstraints: no edits to app.module.ts unless the blueprint says so

commands.name: test
commands.notes: >= baseline count, all green, boot guard (app.module.spec.ts) green

agent.name: ddd-orchestrator
agent.description: Central coordinator of the DDD re-architecture harness (Mixture of Experts). Delegates design to the six expert subagents, execution to the executor subagent, and synthesizes the surgical refactor plan. Only the orchestrator and the executor edit source code, and only after the plan is approved.

execution.sliceRule: one bounded context per slice, behavior-preserving first, characterization tests when coverage is low, refactor separated from redesign
